{{short description|Vietnamese-born artist living in Germany|bot=PearBOT 5}}
'''Dao Droste''' (born 1952) is a [[Vietnam]]ese-born artist living in [[Germany]].

She was born in [[Saigon]] and moved to Germany in 1971. Droste studied chemistry in [[Stuttgart]] and [[Heidelberg]], earning a [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]]. She went on to work in sculpture, painting, and [[installation art]]. She established her own studio in 1987. She now lives in [[Eppelheim]].<ref name=strassacker/>

== Career ==
Her large installation piece "Open-mindedness", which included 500 [[terra cotta]] faces, attracted international attention.<ref name="strassacker" />

As a [[Taoist]], she explores the theme of mankind in harmony with nature in her art.<ref name=klavier>{{cite web |url=http://paque-klavier.de/en/29-04-2017-vernissage-dao-droste-prasentiert-uber-dem-lotossee/ |title=Dao Droste presents "Over the Lotus Sea" |publisher=Paqué Klavier }}{{Dead link|date=September 2023 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>

Droste designed the statue for the One World Award, which is sponsored by [[Rapunzel Naturkost]] and the [[IFOAM - Organics International|International Federation of Organic Agriculture Movements]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.one-world-award.com/owa-statue-dao-droste.html |title=Dao Droste, Artist of the One World Award Statue |work=One World Award}}</ref>

In 2015, she received the environmental prize awarded by the {{ill|German Working Group for Environmental Management|de|Bundesdeutscher Arbeitskreis für Umweltbewusstes Management}} (BAUM).<ref name=klavier/>

Her work is held in public and private collections, including the {{ill|Carl Bosch Museum|de|Carl Bosch Museum Heidelberg}} in Heidelberg, the [[Federal Ministry of Education and Research (Germany)|Federal Ministry of Education and Research]] in Berlin, and the city of Eppelheim.<ref name=strassacker>{{cite web |url=https://www.strassacker.com/en/artists/a-z/dao-droste |title=Dao Droste |publisher=Ernst Strassacker GmbH & Co }}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>
